# wasabi_bucket_object_lock_configuration (Resource)

Manages the Object Lock default retention of a bucket. Object Lock must be enabled when the bucket is created (`object_lock_enabled` of `wasabi_bucket`) and cannot be disabled afterwards, so destroying this resource only removes the default retention rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wasabi_bucket" "example" {
  bucket = "example-bucket"

  # Object Lock can only be enabled when the bucket is created.
  object_lock_enabled = true
}

resource "wasabi_bucket_object_lock_configuration" "example" {
  bucket = wasabi_bucket.example.id

  rule {
    default_retention {
      mode = "GOVERNANCE"
      days = 30
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) The name of the bucket. Object Lock must have been enabled when the bucket was created, see the `object_lock_enabled` argument of `wasabi_bucket`.

### Optional

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `rule` (Block List, Max: 1) The Object Lock rule. Without a rule, new objects get no default retention. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule))

<a id="nestedblock--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule`

Required:

- `default_retention` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) The default retention applied to new objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule--default_retention))

<a id="nestedblock--rule--default_retention"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule.default_retention`

Required:

- `mode` (String) The retention mode, `COMPLIANCE` or `GOVERNANCE`.

Optional:

- `days` (Number) The default retention period in days. Exactly one of `days` and `years` is required.
- `years` (Number) The default retention period in years. Exactly one of `days` and `years` is required.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import wasabi_bucket_object_lock_configuration.example example-bucket
```
